pages.quiz:
GERMAN — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #7
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: GERMAN
TIME ALLOWED: 120 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. What does "Tschüss" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. good day (daytime greeting)
   B. please
   C. yes
   D. bye (friendly)

2. What does "die Gabel" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. table
   B. fork
   C. sofa
   D. chair

3. What does "der Herd" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. fridge
   B. bed
   C. cooker
   D. sofa

4. What does "der Stuhl" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. plate
   B. chair
   C. fridge
   D. bathroom

5. Which day comes right after Donnerstag? (1 mark)
   A. Sonntag
   B. Dienstag
   C. Mittwoch
   D. Freitag

6. What number is "neun"? (1 mark)
   A. 13
   B. 12
   C. 9
   D. 11

7. What number is "sechs"? (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 14
   C. 18
   D. 6

8. What does "Es regnet" mean? (1 mark)
   A. It is snowing
   B. It is hot
   C. It is raining
   D. It is windy

9. What does "sehen" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. to sleep
   B. to hear
   C. to smell
   D. to see

10. Which safety idea is right for the kitchen? (1 mark)
   A. Let children play with matches
   B. Leave the cooker on when you go out
   C. Block the door
   D. Keep hot pots and matches away from small children

11. What can you write when you cannot type "ü"? (1 mark)
   A. ue
   B. ui
   C. uu
   D. u

12. How is the letter M named in German? (1 mark)
   A. ee
   B. tset
   C. emm
   D. eff

13. What should your voice do at a full stop? (1 mark)
   A. Speed up
   B. Whisper
   C. Go down and stop
   D. Go up

14. What does "die Woche" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. Friday
   B. Wednesday
   C. Thursday
   D. week

15. Which day comes right before Mittwoch? (1 mark)
   A. Freitag
   B. Dienstag
   C. Samstag
   D. Montag

16. Which German word means "always"? (time) (1 mark)
   A. heute
   B. immer
   C. oft
   D. gestern

17. What does "September" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. September
   B. December
   C. February
   D. August

18. What does "der Kuchen" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. candle
   B. party
   C. present
   D. cake

19. Which German word is the number 13? (1 mark)
   A. zwölf
   B. vier
   C. eins
   D. dreizehn

20. What does "das Brot" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. onion
   B. bread
   C. cheese
   D. carrot

21. What does "der Tee" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. egg
   B. bean
   C. tea
   D. milk

22. What does "neblig" mean? (1 mark)
   A. foggy
   B. cloudy
   C. sunny
   D. rainy

23. What does "auf" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. in front of
   B. on
   C. under
   D. between

24. Which German word or phrase means "please"? (1 mark)
   A. Hallo
   B. Bis morgen
   C. Guten Tag
   D. Bitte

25. Which German word means "kind"? (describing people) (1 mark)
   A. nett
   B. stark
   C. klein
   D. lustig

26. What is the plural of "das Kind"? (1 mark)
   A. die Kinds
   B. die Kinder
   C. die Kinden
   D. die Kinde

27. Which sentence is written correctly? (1 mark)
   A. Der Tisch ist in dem Küche.
   B. Der Tisch ist im Küche.
   C. Der Tisch ist in der Küche.
   D. Der Tisch ist in der Kuche.

28. Which German word or phrase means "chair"? (1 mark)
   A. die Küche
   B. das Radio
   C. der Stuhl
   D. das Sofa

29. Which German word or phrase means "shower"? (1 mark)
   A. der Kühlschrank
   B. der Tisch
   C. die Dusche
   D. die Wand

30. Which German word means "to dance"? (verb) (1 mark)
   A. duschen
   B. kochen
   C. tanzen
   D. lesen

31. Which German word means "to have a shower"? (verb) (1 mark)
   A. lernen
   B. riechen
   C. duschen
   D. hören

32. How do you say "on the fifth of May"? (1 mark)
   A. an fünften Mai
   B. am fünften Mai
   C. am fünfe Mai
   D. am fünf Mai

33. Which little word goes with the noun "Kuchen"? (1 mark)
   A. das
   B. der
   C. die
   D. den

34. What does "der neunte" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. tenth
   B. ninth
   C. third
   D. eighth

35. Which mark comes after a meal name in a menu, as in "Frühstück: Tee und Brot"? (1 mark)
   A. a full stop
   B. a colon
   C. a hyphen
   D. a question mark

36. Which food group does "der Saft" belong to? (1 mark)
   A. das Gemüse
   B. das Fleisch
   C. das Obst
   D. die Getränke

37. Which food group does "der Apfel" belong to? (1 mark)
   A. die Getränke
   B. das Fleisch
   C. das Gemüse
   D. das Obst

38. What does "Das sind meine Augen" mean? (1 mark)
   A. These are my eyes
   B. That is my nose
   C. These are my ears
   D. This is my eye

39. Which word completes "Ich habe ___ Kopf"? (1 mark)
   A. einen
   B. einer
   C. ein
   D. eine

40. Which weather sentence has the verb in second place? (1 mark)
   A. Es heute regnet.
   B. Heute es regnet.
   C. Heute regnet es.
   D. Regnet heute es

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
41. Write the German words with der, die or das for: leg, house. (2 marks)

42. Write a four-line dialogue in German between two friends who meet in the morning and say goodbye. (4 marks)

43. Write the German words with der, die or das for: supper, shower, bean, fork. (4 marks)

44. Explain how the umlaut changes the word Hand in the plural. (2 marks)

45. Write the German words with der, die or das for: bread, egg, tomato, water. (4 marks)

46. Write these numbers in German: 3, 7, 11. (3 marks)

47. Write in German: "The sun is shining." (2 marks)

48. Write two German sentences about what you would like to do on your birthday. (2 marks)

49. Write the German words with der, die or das for: shoulder, son. (2 marks)

50. Write the German words with der, die or das for: mother, rainbow, hair. (3 marks)

51. Write the German words with der, die or das for: fish, living room, rain. (3 marks)

52. Write in German: "I have two ears." (2 marks)

53. Write the German words with der, die or das for: cocoa, party. (2 marks)

54. Write the German words with der, die or das for: bedroom, chair, window, watermelon. (4 marks)

55. Unscramble the words: SICHT and TETB. Write them with their articles. (2 marks)

56. Write the German greetings for "good morning" and "good evening". (2 marks)

57. Say why we practise tongue twisters when learning to pronounce German. (2 marks)

58. Explain why "Meine Mutter sind nett" is wrong and correct it. (2 marks)

59. Write the German for: I cook, I sleep, I read, I play. (4 marks)

60. Explain how your voice should change for a question mark and for a full stop. (2 marks)

61. Write four short German sentences that a child could say about his or her birthday. (4 marks)

62. Explain how a Rückendiktat is done. (3 marks)
pages.answers:
GERMAN — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #7 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. D — bye (friendly)
   Tschüss means bye (friendly).

2. B — fork
   die Gabel means fork.

3. C — cooker
   der Herd means cooker.

4. B — chair
   der Stuhl means chair.

5. D — Freitag
   After Donnerstag comes Freitag.

6. C — 9
   neun is the number 9.

7. D — 6
   sechs is the number 6.

8. C — It is raining
   regnen is to rain.

9. D — to see
   sehen means to see.

10. D — Keep hot pots and matches away from small children
   Small children must be kept away from heat and matches.

11. A — ue
   ü can be written as ue, ö as oe and ä as ae.

12. C — emm
   In German the letter M is called emm.

13. C — Go down and stop
   A full stop (der Punkt) tells us to end the sentence with a falling voice.

14. D — week
   die Woche means week.

15. B — Dienstag
   Before Mittwoch comes Dienstag.

16. B — immer
   always in German is immer.

17. A — September
   September means September.

18. D — cake
   der Kuchen means cake.

19. D — dreizehn
   13 in German is dreizehn.

20. B — bread
   das Brot means bread.

21. C — tea
   der Tee means tea.

22. A — foggy
   Nebel is fog and neblig means foggy.

23. B — on
   auf means on.

24. D — Bitte
   please in German is Bitte.

25. A — nett
   kind in German is nett.

26. B — die Kinder
   The plural of das Kind is die Kinder.

27. C — Der Tisch ist in der Küche.
   Küche is a die word: in der Küche, with a capital K.

28. C — der Stuhl
   chair in German is der Stuhl.

29. C — die Dusche
   shower in German is die Dusche.

30. C — tanzen
   to dance in German is tanzen.

31. C — duschen
   to have a shower in German is duschen.

32. B — am fünften Mai
   am fünften Mai is correct.

33. B — der
   It is der Kuchen, so the little word is der.

34. B — ninth
   der neunte means ninth.

35. B — a colon
   The colon announces what follows.

36. D — die Getränke
   der Saft belongs to die Getränke.

37. D — das Obst
   der Apfel belongs to das Obst.

38. A — These are my eyes
   sind is used for more than one thing.

39. A — einen
   Kopf is a der word, so we say einen.

40. C — Heute regnet es.
   regnet is the second word.

SECTION B
----
41. (2 marks)
   Answer: das Bein, das Haus.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (2 marks).

42. (4 marks)
   Answer: A: Guten Morgen, Amina! B: Guten Morgen, Otieno! Wie geht's? A: Gut, danke. B: Tschüss!
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct line with capital letters and punctuation.

43. (4 marks)
   Answer: das Abendessen, die Dusche, die Bohne, die Gabel.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (4 marks).

44. (2 marks)
   Answer: a becomes ä, so die Hand becomes die Hände.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the vowel change and 1 mark for the plural.

45. (4 marks)
   Answer: das Brot, das Ei, die Tomate, das Wasser.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

46. (3 marks)
   Answer: drei, sieben, elf.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correctly spelled number.

47. (2 marks)
   Answer: Die Sonne scheint.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for Die Sonne and 1 mark for scheint.

48. (2 marks)
   Answer: For example: Ich möchte tanzen. Ich möchte Kuchen essen.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct sentence.

49. (2 marks)
   Answer: die Schulter, der Sohn.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (2 marks).

50. (3 marks)
   Answer: die Mutter, der Regenbogen, das Haar.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (3 marks).

51. (3 marks)
   Answer: der Fisch, das Wohnzimmer, der Regen.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (3 marks).

52. (2 marks)
   Answer: Ich habe zwei Ohren.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for Ich habe zwei and 1 mark for Ohren.

53. (2 marks)
   Answer: der Kakao, die Party.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (2 marks).

54. (4 marks)
   Answer: das Schlafzimmer, der Stuhl, das Fenster, die Wassermelone.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (4 marks).

55. (2 marks)
   Answer: der Tisch, das Bett.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each word with article.

56. (2 marks)
   Answer: Guten Morgen and Guten Abend.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each greeting spelled correctly.

57. (2 marks)
   Answer: They repeat similar sounds, so the tongue and lips learn to move clearly and smoothly.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for repeated sounds and 1 mark for clear speech.

58. (2 marks)
   Answer: With one person we use ist. Correct: Meine Mutter ist nett.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the reason and 1 mark for the correction.

59. (4 marks)
   Answer: Ich koche, ich schlafe, ich lese, ich spiele.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

60. (2 marks)
   Answer: It goes up at a question mark and down at a full stop.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

61. (4 marks)
   Answer: For example: Ich bin heute zehn. Ich habe einen Kuchen. Meine Familie ist da. Alles Gute zum Geburtstag!
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct sentence.

62. (3 marks)
   Answer: A partner traces letters on your back; you say the letters aloud and write the word.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each of the steps: tracing, saying, writing.
